title: The sphere tangent bundle is stably trivial
promptMarkdown: Construct explicitly a smooth vector-bundle isomorphism $TS^n\oplus\underline{\mathbb R}\cong\underline{\mathbb R}^{n+1}$ over $S^n$. Prove its inverse is smooth and fibrewise linear. Relate the construction to the tangent space of a regular level set, and explain why it does not prove that $TS^n$ itself is trivial. Give a global frame of $TS^1$ directly.
hintLadder: Split an ambient vector into tangential and radial parts.
Find the radial coefficient by a dot product with $p$.
In dimension one, rotate $p$ through a right angle.

criteria.criterion: Correct explicit bundle map and inverse.
